mapper.select: SELECT mi.MENU_NO, mi.UPPER_MENU_NO, mi.MENU_NM, mi.MENU_ORDR, mi.PROGRM_FILE_NM, pl.URL FROM COMTNMENUINFO mi JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST pl ON pl.PROGRM_FILE_NM = mi.PROGRM_FILE_NM WHERE pl.URL = #{url} ORDER BY mi.MENU_NO
SELECT cd.AUTHOR_CODE FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS cd JOIN COMTNMENUINFO mi ON mi.MENU_NO = cd.MENU_NO JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST pl ON pl.PROGRM_FILE_NM = mi.PROGRM_FILE_NM WHERE pl.URL = #{url}

SELECT SUBSTR(pl.URL, INSTR(pl.URL, 'bbsId=') + 6) AS BBS_ID, mi.MENU_NO, mi.UPPER_MENU_NO, mi.MENU_NM, mi.MENU_ORDR, mi.PROGRM_FILE_NM, pl.URL FROM COMTNMENUINFO mi JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST pl ON pl.PROGRM_FILE_NM = mi.PROGRM_FILE_NM WHERE pl.URL LIKE #{urlPrefix} || '%' AND INSTR(pl.URL, 'bbsId=') > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{progrmFileNm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNPROGRMLIST (PROGRM_FILE_NM, PROGRM_STRE_PATH, PROGRM_KOREAN_NM, PROGRM_DC, URL) VALUES (#{progrmFileNm}, '/cop/bbs/user/', #{menuNm}, '사용자 게시판 열람 (게시판속성관리에서 자동 생성)', #{url})
INSERT INTO COMTNMENUINFO (MENU_NO, UPPER_MENU_NO, MENU_NM, PROGRM_FILE_NM, MENU_ORDR, MENU_DC, MENU_SE) VALUES (#{menuNo}, #{upperMenuNo}, #{menuNm}, #{progrmFileNm}, #{menuOrdr}, #{menuNm}, 'USER')
INSERT INTO COMTNMENUCREATDTLS (MENU_NO, AUTHOR_CODE, MAPNG_CREAT_ID) VALUES (#{menuNo}, #{authorCode}, NULL)
